name: Immigrant Residence Permit (G Category)

requirements.blocker_text: 3 consecutive years of legal residence in Mongolia immediately prior to applying.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous legal residence under a qualifying temporary permit.

requirements.blocker_text: Monthly income at least 5 times the Mongolian minimum wage.
Undergraduate or graduate degree, or a specialization identified as needed by Mongolia.
No criminal background; never subject to deportation or an entry ban to Mongolia.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 3 years' continuous legal residence
Degree certificate or proof of needed specialization

outcome.duration_length: not explicitly stated as a fixed term in the source; status is cancellable on absence exceeding 180 days in a year, otherwise functions as Mongolia's ongoing immigrant/settlement status
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: absence exceeding 180 days in a year may result in cancellation of status

sources.title: Immigration Agency of Mongolia -- G ('immigrant') residence permit: 3 years' prior continuous legal residence, income 5x minimum wage, degree or needed specialization, no criminal record or deportation history, children under 18 get matching permit duration, 135,000 MNT fee, 60-day processing, cancellable after 180+ days' annual absence

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Mongolia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 sourced. NAMING NOTE: this route is officially the 'G' or 'immigrant' residence permit category, not literally titled 'permanent residence' by the Immigration Agency -- it is modeled under this dataset's standard 'permanent_residence' filename because it functions as Mongolia's closest equivalent: an ongoing, renewable settlement status reached after prior temporary residence, requiring no further upgrade before naturalisation eligibility. The source did not state a fixed card-validity term (unlike most other countries' PR permits in this dataset, which typically specify e.g. '10 years') -- disclosed as a gap rather than assumed. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the Law on Citizenship's Article 9 requirement of 5 years' 'permanent residence' specifically (as opposed to any legal residence) before naturalisation eligibility -- see mn_citizenship_naturalisation.json. Total realistic timeline from first entry to citizenship eligibility is therefore approximately 3 years (to reach G status) + 5 years (on G status) = 8 years, a structure worth flagging since it is not a single continuous 8-year count against one requirement, unlike Romania's Article 8(1)(a).
